title: validate policy
description: What `validate` holds this project to: data/validate.json, read by scripts/validate_tree.py (policy()). A project without the file has its git-tracked runs* directories checked, no floors, no scorer sources and only the bundled demo's duplicate exception.

_comment.description: Notes for a person reading the file; validate ignores them.

committed.description: The run directories reports cite, relative to data/: V7 (every run has metrics.json), V8 (no duplicate config_id) and V9 (every tracked file on disk).

floors.description: V9: each directory must keep at least this many runs, so deleting evidence fails; raising one is a deliberate edit.

scorer_sources.description: V10: runs that claim the current scorer, and the code that says what the current scorer is.

dir.description: The runs directory, relative to data/.

glob.description: Which of its runs, by name.

path.description: Where in a run's metrics.json the scorer it claims is.

module.description: A .py path relative to this project's root.

callable.description: Returns a hash, or a dict of named hashes.

duplicate_ok.description: V8: (dataset_id, config_id) pairs allowed to repeat, each one justified.

configs.description: V18: globs, relative to this project's root, of arm configs kept outside data/configs (the examples' arms), so their model_record notes are seen.
